what: Glass pill button — three accent-colored light blobs slowly orbit inside (canvas, 6px blur · 1.2x), and on hover the text rolls up one line and a second copy stands in (first line -120% · second line -110%, .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) while accent light spreads below the button from .6 to 1x (.4s). The border is a 1px diagonal gradient

options.speed: Speed of the orbiting light blob, default .6 (0 stops it)
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Button text (child). The part clones a second copy and attaches it below

note: Light colors read --kf-accent·--kf-accent-soft·--kf-surface and re-read when data-theme changes. On touch devices (hover false) only the blob rotates, with no rolling or spreading

from.where: shared.css .em-btn — header Contact button · entrance door ‹With Sound› · Footer · card buttons (original Button: button__canvas-container·button__content-sub·button__shadow)
